display_name: 源 IQ 相位曲率的跨 TX、跨日重复性证伪
description: 幅度响应候选结束后，只用合法L6300的已知L-STF频点，排除整体复增益、线性相位及时域CFO；18折跨TX/day检查RX关联。零模型、零权重、零目标，不直接训练新增强。
authorization: Current active goal authorizes source-grounded Ag research. No additional model/epoch budget consumed. Source-only no-model diagnostic, original CVS/default head/test inputs unchanged.

permissions.query_use: None; no target loader or truth; no model
permissions.claim_scope: Received source phase association only. Not calibrated RX hardware, identity survival, or clean/urban benefit.

checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed primary80:160; all ten coordinates and18 heldTX/day folds. No sourceV fit, no candidate/window selection or automatic training.

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only; CUDA hidden;2 threads; no GPU reservation or foreign process changes
execution.stop_rule: Own technical failure preserves immutable outputs and stops; no automatic retry. Scientific primaryFAIL ends phase-augmentation hypothesis; PASS only permits a separate source finiteIQ/defaulthead safety design, no training promotion.

metric_names: crossfit circular risk gain vs pooled noRX mean

rows.method: 10 gauge-null known-tone closures and deterministic circular means
rows.seed_notes: Existing split/data392005; model/augmentation/support/evaluation null because no model, perturbation, support or predictions. Checks use synthetic RNG20261016041/043 only, not real source fit.
rows.scenario: clean L_s only; original test IQ untouched
rows.budget_ref: One existing L6300 IQ read,3 windows=18900 observations/75600 cycles;0 models/checkpoint loads/network forwards/updates/target predictions

config.CFO: same wrapped lag20 estimator as existing known-excitation diagnostic; alias period 1.25MHz
config.phase_coordinates: 10 full-rank integer closure coordinates on 12 known L-STF tones, null constant/linear phase
config.crossfit: 18 folds; exclude held TX AND held day from both RX and pooled means; equal cell weight
config.controls: four cyclic wrong-RX mean assignments, same eligible observations
config.secondary_windows: report only, never replace primary or tune thresholds
config.interpretation: RX-associated phase repeatability of received IQ only; not identified RX hardware or proven identity benefit

notes: Data handle reuse; cached old V/features are deserialized by legacy torch container but never read by statistics. Only L x,y,rx,day,ids extracted; no U labels or model states consumed.
10 integer closures have rank10 and annihilate constant/linear phase. Known excitation coefficient signs fixed from already verified project implementation. No unwrap, no perTX hardware inversion.
Wrapped lag20 CFO at25MHz alias1.25MHz; IQ conjugation/template/time ambiguity retained. Per-cycle repeatability ratio is not measured totalSNR or uniquely added-noise SNR.
Primary thresholds frozen in config before any new source phase array. Equal TX/day/RX cell weight. All90 cells contain70L; each of10 coordinates needs20 eligible observations.

Criterion: riskgain>=.02;14/18positive folds; all5RX>=0; gain over best four cyclic wrongRX>=.01; allfitresultants>=.5; eachRX mean splitcos>=.8. All required; sparse/unstable phase fails rather than lowering thresholds.

Historical phase-curvature network branches and finite-margin/time-shift attempts are preserved negatives, not current allowed heads or branches. This experiment neither deploys them nor loads old weights.
Source-only metadata diagnostic does not train a model and therefore has no formal test/prediction stage; no performance claim or target-driven promotion. Shared L cache is not new training data.
